---
title: "Fisheries Data"
---

```{r}
library(plotly)
library(reactable)
d <- read.csv("data/landings.csv")
plot_ly(d, x = ~year, y = ~tonnes, color = ~species, type = "bar") |>
  layout(barmode = "stack", xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Landings (tonnes)"))
```

::: {.plain-words}
**How to read this:** each coloured block is one species; the full bar height is total landings for that year.
:::

## Table

```{r}
reactable(d, searchable = TRUE, filterable = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 10)
```
